title: Macro-economic role of military expenditure in OECD countries 1978-1979
authors: Smith, R.P., Deger, S., Birkbeck College, Dep. of economics * London, Great Britain (primary investigator)
descriptions: A consistent set of economic time series for 12 variables and 14 OECD countries for the years 1953-1973 were assembled to test various hypotheses on the macro-economic role of military expenditure.
